auth_token.description: Authentication tokens, also known as JSON Web Tokens (JWT), are a method for authenticating Splunk platform users into the Splunk platform. May also be provided via STACK_TOKEN environment variable.

password.description: Splunk Cloud Platform deployment password. May also be provided via STACK_PASSWORD environment variable.

server.description: ACS API base URL. May also be provided via ACS_SERVER environment variable.

splunk_password.description: Splunk.com account password. Required when `splunk_username` is set. Used to authenticate with splunkbase.splunk.com and api.splunk.com for Splunkbase app installs and AppInspect validation. May also be provided via SPLUNK_PASSWORD environment variable.

splunk_username.description: Splunk.com account username. Required only when managing Splunkbase apps, private apps with pre-vetting (AppInspect), or the `scp_app_validation` data source. Used to authenticate with splunkbase.splunk.com and api.splunk.com. May also be provided via SPLUNK_USERNAME environment variable.

stack.description: Stack to perform ACS operations. May also be provided via SPLUNK_STACK environment variable.

username.description: Splunk Cloud Platform deployment username. May also be provided via STACK_USERNAME environment variable.

_meta.description: Metadata for the HEC token in the format: key::value, delimited by spaces.

allowed_indexes.description: Set of indexes allowed for events with this token

default_index.description: Index to store generated events. Must not be an empty string. If allowed_indexes is provided, default_index must be one of allowed_indexes

default_source.description: Default source for events with this token

default_sourcetype.description: Default sourcetype for events with this token

disabled.description: Input disabled indicator: false = Input Not disabled, true = Input disabled

name.description: The name of the hec token to create. Can not be updated after creation, if changed in config file terraform will propose a replacement (delete old hec token and recreate with new name)

token.description: Token value for sending data to collector/event endpoint. Can not be updated after creation, if changed in config file terraform will propose a replacement (delete old HEC and recreate with new token)

use_ack.description: Indexer acknowledgement for this token: false = disabled, true = enabled

block.description: Hec Token Resource. Please refer to https://docs.splunk.com/Documentation/SplunkCloud/latest/Config/ManageHecTokens for more latest, detailed information on attribute requirements and the ACS Hec Token API.

datatype.description: Valid values: (event | metric). Specifies the type of index. Can not be updated. Defaults to event. Can not be updated after creation, if changed in config file terraform will propose a replacement (delete current index and recreate with new datatype).

max_data_size_mb.description: The maximum size in MB for a hot DB to reach before a roll to warm is triggered. Defaults to 0 (unlimited).

name.description: The name of the index to create. Can not be updated after creation, if changed in config file terraform will propose a replacement (delete old index and recreate with new name).

searchable_days.description: Number of days after which indexed data rolls to frozen. Defaults to 90 days.

self_storage_bucket_path.description: To create an index with DDSS enabled, you must specify the selfStorageBucketPath value in the following format: "s3://selfStorageBucket/selfStorageBucketFolder", where SelfStorageBucketFolder is optional, as you can store data buckets at root. Before you can create an index with DDSS enabled, you must configure a self-storage location for your deployment (see https://docs.splunk.com/Documentation/SplunkCloud/latest/Config/ManageDDSSlocations). Can not be set with splunk_archival_retention_days.

splunk_archival_retention_days.description: To create an index with DDAA enabled, you must specify the splunkArchivalRetentionDays value which must be The value of splunkArchivalRetentionDays must be positive and greater than the SearchableDays value. Can not be set with self_storage_bucket_path.

block.description: Index Resource. Please refer to https://docs.splunk.com/Documentation/SplunkCloud/latest/Config/ManageIndexes for more latest, detailed information on attribute requirements and the ACS Indexes API.

feature.description: Feature is a specified component in your Splunk Cloud Platform. Eg: search-api, hec, etc. No two resources should have the same feature. Use this value as the resource name itself to enforce this rule.

subnets.description: Subnets is a list of IP addresses that have access to the corresponding feature.

block.description: IP Allowlist Resource. Please see documentation to understand unique behavior regarding naming and delete operation. Please refer to https://docs.splunk.com/Documentation/SplunkCloud/latest/Config/ConfigureIPAllowList for more latest, detailed information on attribute requirements and the ACS IP Allowlist API.

feature.description: Feature is a specified component in your Splunk Cloud Platform. Eg: search-api, hec, etc. No two resources should have the same feature. Use this value as the resource name itself to enforce this rule.

subnets.description: Subnets is a list of IPv6 addresses that have access to the corresponding feature.

block.description: IPv6 Allowlist Resource. Please see documentation to understand unique behavior regarding naming and delete operation. Please refer to https://docs.splunk.com/Documentation/SplunkCloud/latest/Config/ConfigureIPAllowList for more latest, detailed information on attribute requirements and the ACS IP Allowlist API.

acs_legal_ack.description: When you install a private app, you must also specify the ACS-Legal-Ack: Y parameter to acknowledge your acceptance of any risks involved with the installation of unsupported apps on your system, as specified in the Splunk legal disclaimer for app installation, which is provided in the ACS OpenAPI 3.0 specification. To review the disclaimer, see Set up the ACS API: https://docs.splunk.com/Documentation/SplunkCloud/latest/Config/ACSusage#Set_up_the_ACS_API

filename.description: The path to the private app file. The file must be a valid tar.gz archive.

name.description: The name of the private app

pre_vetted.description: Whether the private app has been pre-vetted using AppInspect.

targets.description: List of search head targets to install the application on. Note: TAI functionality must be enabled on the stack and if the app has been previously installed it needs to be imported to Terraform.

block.description: Private App. Please refer to https://docs.splunk.com/Documentation/SplunkCloud/latest/Config/ManageApps for more latest, detailed information on attribute requirements and the ACS API.

capabilities.description: The capabilities attached to the role.

cumulative_rt_srch_jobs_quota.description: Maximum number of concurrently running real-time searches that all members of this role can have. The value must be a non-negative number.

cumulative_srch_jobs_quota.description: Maximum number of concurrently running historical searches that all members of this role can have. The value must be a non-negative number.

default_app.description: Set the default app for this role.

federated_search_manage_ack.description: If 'imported_roles' or 'capabilities' contains the 'fsh_manage' capability, you must set this attribute to a value of "Y". This header acknowledges that a role with the 'fsh_manage' capability can send search results outside the compliant environment.

imported_roles.description: List of other roles and their associated capabilities that should be imported.

name.description: The name of the role to create. Can not be updated after creation, if changed in config file terraform will propose a replacement (delete old role and recreate with new name).

rt_srch_jobs_quota.description: Maximum number of concurrently running real-time searches a member of this role can have. The value must be a non-negative number.

srch_disk_quota.description: Maximum amount of disk space (MB) that can be used by search jobs of a user that belongs to this role. The value must be a non-negative number.

srch_filter.description: List of search filters for this Role.

srch_indexes_allowed.description: List of indexes this role is allowed to search.

srch_indexes_default.description: List of indexes to search when no index is specified.

srch_jobs_quota.description: Maximum number of concurrently running historical searches a member of this role can have. The value must be a non-negative number.

srch_time_earliest.description: Maximum amount of time that searches of users from this role will be allowed to run. A value of -1 means unset, 0 means infinite. Any other value is the amount of time in seconds, for example, 300 would mean 300s.

srch_time_win.description: Maximum time span of a search, in seconds. A value of -1 means unset, 0 means infinite. Any other value is the amount of time in seconds, for example, 300 would mean 300s.

block.description: Role Resource. Please refer to https://docs.splunk.com/Documentation/SplunkCloud/latest/Config/ManageRoles for more latest, detailed information on attribute requirements and the ACS Roles API.

acs_licensing_ack.description: The app's third-party license URL. The license URL is available under 'Licensing' on the Splunkbase download page for the app.

name.description: The name of the Splunkbase app

splunkbase_id.description: The ID of the Splunkbase app

targets.description: List of roles to install the application on. Note: TAI functionality must be enabled on the stack and if the app has been previously installed it needs to be imported to the terraform.

version.description: The version of the Splunkbase app

block.description: Splunkbase App. Please refer to https://docs.splunk.com/Documentation/SplunkCloud/9.3.2408/Config/ManageSplunkbaseApps for more latest, detailed information on attribute requirements and the ACS API.

default_app.description: Set the default app for this user. Setting this here overrides the default app inherited from the user's role(s).

default_app_source.description: Default app source of the user.

email.description: The email of the user to create.

federated_search_manage_ack.description: If any role contains the 'fsh_manage' capability you must set this attribute to a value of "Y". This header acknowledges that a role with the fsh_manage capability can send search results outside the compliant environment.

force_change_pass.description: To force a change of password on the user's first login, set forceChangePass to "true".

full_name.description: The full name of the user to create.

last_successful_login.description: (Read-only) Last successful login timestamp of the user.

locked_out.description: (Read-only) Whether the user account has been locked out.

name.description: The name of the user to create. Can not be updated after creation, if changed in config file terraform will propose a replacement (delete old user and recreate with new name).

old_password.description: The old password of the user to update. To protect your password, you can replace the credentials with variables configured with the sensitive flag, and set values for these variables using environment variables or with a .tfvars file. Please refer to https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/tutorials/configuration-language/sensitive-variables for more details.

password.description: The password of the user to create, or the new password to update. To protect your password, you can replace the credentials with variables configured with the sensitive flag, and set values for these variables using environment variables or with a .tfvars file. Please refer to https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/tutorials/configuration-language/sensitive-variables for more details.

roles.description: Assign one of more roles to this user. The user will inherit all the settings and capabilities from those roles.

block.description: User Resource. Please refer to https://docs.splunk.com/Documentation/SplunkCloud/latest/Config/ManageRoles for more latest, detailed information on attribute requirements and the ACS Users API.

pre_vetted.description: Whether the app has been pre-vetted successfully.

request_id.description: The ID of the validation request.

status.description: The current status of the validation request.

block.description: Use this data source to check the validation status of a private app.Please refer to https://docs.splunk.com/Documentation/SplunkCloud/latest/Config/ManageApps for more latest, detailed information on attribute requirements and the ACS API.

Index Data Source. Use this data source to reference default indexes (https://docs.splunk.com/Documentation/Splunk/latest/Indexer/Aboutmanagingindexes) or other indexes you do not wish Terraform to execute write operations on.
